jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established experts to sit on an advisory committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role; it seeks recognised expertise (activists and specialists from the named regions) that the candidate does not have. The Spanish-language convocatoria and regional focus also imply working expertise the candidate lacks, and there is no salaried vacancy here.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an Advisory Committee, not a paid entry-level role — it seeks established specialists with deep, region-specific expertise in environmental defender criminalisation, which the candidate lacks. It also reads as an advisory/voluntary position rather than a genuine paid vacancy, and the deadline has already passed. The human-rights subject is interesting, but the level and nature of the posting are a hard mismatch.
